designSummary: Conditional logistic regression on matched sets from the tertiary ED.
sampleSize: At the tertiary ED about 1,050 people a year meet the definition and about 6 percent die or are admitted to ICU within 12 months (claim c6), giving about 189 cases for index dates from March 2023 to December 2025. With four controls per case and enrolment in about 21 percent of controls, 189 cases give about 62 percent power at two-sided alpha 0.05 to detect an odds ratio of 0.6; 80 percent power needs about 277 cases. The single site is therefore underpowered for the effect the program would need to show.
primaryAnalysis: Conditional logistic regression for enrolment before the index date, adjusted for prior-year visits, comorbidity index, mental health diagnosis, housing instability and family doctor attachment.
missingData: Files that cannot be found are reported; multiple imputation for missing housing status.
summary: About 189 cases at one site give only about 62 percent power for an odds ratio of 0.6; 277 cases are needed.
